verdict.rationale: Replit markets adding AI to generated apps ('Enhance your apps with AI… Connect to OpenAI… in minutes'). Its connectors let an admin set up a service once for builders to reuse across apps, which reduces per-app credential handling. However, no evidence explicitly says LLM calls or agents work without the user supplying or managing provider API keys; the 'no copy-pasting of keys' claim applies only to built-in auth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of keyless or Replit-managed LLM access in generated apps, any evidence of in-app agent features, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
